modules.title: Lepton doublets
modules.doc:
The value space of the lepton doublet `(1, 2)_{-3}`, its Lorentz and gauge actions, their
kernel and descent, and the actions and gauge weights on components.

## i. Overview

The Standard Model lepton doublet is a left-handed Weyl spinor in the `(1, 2)_{-3}`
representation. Here charges are normalized as `6Y`, so `-3` is the usual hypercharge
`Y = -1/2`.

`LeptonDoubletV` is its target space, a left-handed Weyl spinor tensored with the weak
coordinates. The Lorentz group acts on the Weyl factor, the global gauge group on the weak
factor by its `SU(2)` matrix scaled by the hypercharge phase.

The gauge action is computed on a basis, used to identify its kernel, and descended to
each supported global form of the Standard Model gauge group. Both actions are then written on
the basis together with their dual, conjugate and conjugate-dual forms, which are what a
component of a lepton-doublet symbol needs. The centre `-1` of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts by `-1`, as on
any single Weyl-spinor index, and the gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis, with the isospin
weights and hypercharge `-3`.

## ii. Key results

- `LeptonDoubletV` : the target space of the `(1, 2)_{-3}` multiplet.
- `repLorentzGroup` : the left-handed Lorentz action.
- `repGaugeGroupI` : the action of the unquotiented gauge group.
- `repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis` : the gauge action in the spinor–weak basis.
- `mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq` : the kernel of the full-group action.
- `gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI` : triviality of the central `ℤ₆`.
- `repGaugeGroup` : the action descended to every supported gauge-group quotient.
- `repLorentzGroup_neg_one` : the centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts by `-1`.
- `valueGaugeWeight` : the gauge weights of the basis, with
  `repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The lepton-doublet space
- B. The basis
- C. Lorentz action
- D. Gauge action
- E. Kernel of the gauge action
- F. Descent to quotient gauge groups
- G. Component transformation laws
- H. The gauge weights of the components

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. The lepton-doublet space

The Weyl factor carries the left-handed Lorentz index, while the functions on `Fin 2`
carry the weak index.
## B. The basis

## C. Lorentz action

The Lorentz group acts on the left-handed Weyl factor and leaves the weak index fixed.

## D. Gauge action

The colour factor acts trivially, while `SU(2)` acts on the weak index. The `U(1)` action
is `star z ^ 3`; since `z` is unitary, `star z = z⁻¹`, so this represents charge `-3`.

The tensor and basis formulas below expose the coefficients used to compare actions and
compute the kernel.

## E. Kernel of the gauge action

An element acts trivially when its weak action is scalar and that scalar cancels its
`U(1)` phase. Its colour component is unrestricted because the lepton doublet is an
`SU(3)` singlet.

## F. Descent to quotient gauge groups

A representation descends through a quotient when the quotient subgroup lies in its
kernel. For the central `ℤ₆`, the weak central phase and charge `-3` phase combine to a
sixth power and therefore act trivially.

## G. Component transformation laws

The basis of `LeptonDoubletV` splits as a left-handed Weyl index and a weak-isospin index.
The Lorentz group moves only the first, the gauge group only the second (up to the
hypercharge scalar), so both actions are recorded as a single sum over the index they move.
Dualising inverts and transposes the coefficient matrix, and conjugating stars it. The four
combinations below are what a component of a lepton-doublet symbol needs.

## H. The gauge weights of the components

The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonDoubletV`. The weights are recorded by
`LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight`, and pass to the dual and conjugate-dual coordinate
functionals with the expected signs.

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV
declarations.doc:
The target vector space of one Standard Model lepton doublet, a left-handed Weyl spinor
tensored with the weak coordinates. It carries the `(1, 2)_{-3}` representation of the
gauge group.
declarations.statement: abbrev LeptonDoubletV : Type

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.basis
declarations.doc:
A basis on the lepton doublets, the Weyl basis tensored with the coordinate basis of
the weak index.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.basis_apply
declarations.doc: The lepton-doublet basis vector as an explicit spinor–weak tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_apply (k j : Fin 2) :
    basis (k, j) = Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] Pi.single j 1

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The left-handed Lorentz representation on lepton doublets, the left-handed Weyl action on
the spinor factor and trivial on the weak index.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℂ (SL(2,ℂ)) LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_tmul
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on a pure spinor–weak tensor is the left-handed action on the Weyl
factor, the weak index untouched.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_tmul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (s : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl) (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (s ⊗ₜ v) = Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep Λ s ⊗ₜ v

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI
declarations.doc:
The `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the unquotiented Standard Model gauge group. The `SU(2)` matrix,
scaled by the hypercharge factor `star u ^ 3`, acts on the weak index. Since `u` is unitary,
`star u = u⁻¹`, so this is charge `-3`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repGaugeGroupI : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_tmul
declarations.doc:
On a pure spinor–weak tensor the `SU(2)` matrix, scaled by the hypercharge factor, acts on
the weak index.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul (g : GaugeGroupI) (v : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl) (w : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (v ⊗ₜ w) = v ⊗ₜ ((star g.toU1.1 ^ 3) • g.toSU2.1).mulVec w

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the lepton-doublet basis. The spinor index is inert and the weak
index transforms by the `SU(2)` matrix, scaled by the hypercharge factor.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis j) =
      ∑ w, (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2) • basis (j.1, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum
declarations.doc: Expands the lepton-doublet gauge action on a tensor-product basis vector.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum (g : GaugeGroupI) (k j : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis (k, j)) =
      ∑ j' : Fin 2, (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g.toSU2.1 j' j) • basis (k, j')

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq
declarations.doc:
Two gauge elements induce the same action exactly when their weak-basis coefficients
agree.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq {g₁ g₂ : GaugeGroupI} :
    repGaugeGroupI g₁ = repGaugeGroupI g₂ ↔ ∀ j j',
    star g₁.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g₁.toSU2.1 j' j =
      star g₂.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g₂.toSU2.1 j' j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq
declarations.doc: Characterizes the full-group elements acting trivially on the lepton doublet.
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq {g : GaugeGroupI} :
    g ∈ repGaugeGroupI.ker ↔ ∃ a : ℂ, g.toSU2.1 = a • 1 ∧
      a * star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 = 1

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI
declarations.doc: The central `ℤ₆` subgroup acts trivially on `(1, 2)_{-3}`.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI :
    GaugeGroupQuot.subgroup .ℤ₆ ≤ repGaugeGroupI.ker

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI
declarations.doc: Every supported quotient subgroup acts trivially on the lepton doublet.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI (Q : GaugeGroupQuot) :
    Q.subgroup ≤ repGaugeGroupI.ker

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroup
declarations.doc:
The `(1, 2)_{-3}` representation for every supported global form of the
Standard Model gauge group.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def repGaugeGroup : (Q : GaugeGroupQuot) →
    Representation ℂ (GaugeGroup Q) LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the lepton-doublet basis. The weak index is inert and the
spinor index transforms by the matrix itself.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis j) = ∑ β, Λ.1 β j.1 • basis (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The lepton-doublet coordinate functionals transform contragrediently, by the
inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β • basis.dualBasis (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate lepton-doublet basis. The coefficients are the
conjugates of those of the lepton-doublet action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) j)
      = ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β j.1) • (Basis.conj basis) (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The conjugate lepton-doublet coordinate functionals transform by the entrywise
conjugate of the inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β) • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the lepton-doublet space by `-1`. The value space carries a
single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer spin.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre acts on the conjugate lepton-doublet space by `-1` as well, conjugation not
moving a real sign.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The lepton-doublet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action, by the
hypercharge and `SU(2)` factors of the inverse group element, transposed.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ w, (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 3 * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2 w) • basis.dualBasis (j.1, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the conjugate lepton-doublet basis has the coefficients of the
lepton-doublet action, conjugated.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ w, star (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2) • (Basis.conj basis) (j.1, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The conjugate lepton-doublet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
contragredient gauge action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ w, star (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 3 * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2 w) •
        (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (j.1, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight
declarations.doc:
The gauge weight of the lepton-doublet basis, isospin weight and hypercharge
`-3`.
declarations.statement: def valueGaugeWeight (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : GaugeWeight

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonDoubletV`, with the weights
`LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight`.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonDoubletV.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        LeptonDoubletV.basis j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
`LeptonDoubletV` negates the weights.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonDoubletV.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        LeptonDoubletV.basis.coord j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
of the conjugate of `LeptonDoubletV`. The two negations cancel and the weights are those of
the value space.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i)
      (((Basis.conj LeptonDoubletV.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj LeptonDoubletV.basis)).coord j

modules.title: The infinitesimal gauge action on the lepton doublet
modules.doc:
The explicit `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge algebra on the lepton doublet, and its agreement
with the matter field.

## i. Overview

In the infinitesimal `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge algebra on the lepton doublet, the
weak part of the algebra element acts on the weak index and the hypercharge part scales,
both through the physicists' factor of `i`, matching the group action
`(star u) ^ 3 • U₂` infinitesimally. This action is the action of the Lie algebra of the
global gauge group on the matter field of the lepton doublet, transported along
`StandardModel.gaugeAlgebraEquiv`, and it commutes with the Lorentz action.

## ii. Key results

- `weakEnd` : the endomorphism of the lepton doublet defined by a `2 × 2` matrix on the
  weak index.
- `gaugeAlgebraAction` : the infinitesimal `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge algebra.
- `matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv` : the gauge-algebra action is the action of
  the matter field of the lepton doublet.
- `gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup` : the gauge action commutes with the Lorentz
  action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The action of the gauge algebra
- B. The action of the matter field
- C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

## iv. References

* None.

## B. The action of the matter field

The action of the Lie algebra of the global gauge group on the matter field of the lepton
doublet is the gauge-algebra action, transported along `gaugeAlgebraEquiv`.
## C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd
declarations.doc:
The endomorphism of the lepton doublet defined by a `2 × 2` complex matrix acting on
the weak index, with the Weyl factor untouched.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def weakEnd (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    LeptonDoubletV →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_add
declarations.statement:
lemma weakEnd_add (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    weakEnd (A + B) = weakEnd A + weakEnd B

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma weakEnd_smul (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    weakEnd (z • A) = z • weakEnd A

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.actionMatrix
declarations.doc:
The matrix of the infinitesimal `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of a gauge algebra element on
the weak index, `i` times the weak part shifted by `i` times `-3` the
hypercharge.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def actionMatrix (c : GaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the lepton doublet, the
derivative of the `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge group, real-linear in the
algebra slot and complex-linear in the value slot.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LeptonDoubletV →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.derivMat_gaugeRep_gaugeAlgebraEquiv
declarations.doc:
The action matrix of the gauge representation of the lepton doublet on the image of a gauge
algebra element under `gaugeAlgebraEquiv` is the action matrix of the gauge algebra.
declarations.statement:
lemma derivMat_gaugeRep_gaugeAlgebraEquiv (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    derivMat gaugeRep (gaugeAlgebraEquiv c) = actionMatrix c

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv
declarations.doc:
The action of the gauge algebra of the matter field of the lepton doublet, on the
image of a gauge algebra element under `gaugeAlgebraEquiv`, is `gaugeAlgebraAction`.
declarations.statement:
lemma matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    matterField.repAlgebra (gaugeAlgebraEquiv c) = gaugeAlgebraAction c

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the lepton doublet acts on the weak factor, the
Lorentz action on the Weyl factor, so the two commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : LeptonDoubletV) :
    LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction c (LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup Λ (LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

modules.title: The lepton doublet as a matter field
modules.doc:
The lepton doublet `(1, 2)_{-3}` as a matter field of the Standard Model global gauge
group.

## i. Overview

The target space `LeptonDoubletV` is normed by the coordinates of its basis. A lepton doublet
is a left-handed Weyl spinor with a weak index, and the global gauge group acts on the weak
index by its `SU(2)` block scaled by the power `-3` of the hypercharge phase. This is the
charge `-3` twist of the fundamental representation of `SU(2)`, which gives a matter field of
mass weight three. Its action of the global gauge group, on the image of
`StandardModel.gaugeGroupEquiv`, is the existing action
`StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI`.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.matterField` : the lepton doublet as a matrix matter
  field of `StandardModel.globalGaugeGroup`.
- `StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.matterField_repAlgebra` : its action of the gauge
  algebra.
- `StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.matterField_rep_gaugeGroupEquiv` : its action of the
  gauge group is `StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI`.
- `StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.matterField_lorentzContinuous`,
  `StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.matterField_gaugeLorentzCommute` :
  its Lorentz action is continuous and commutes with its gauge action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The normed structure
- B. The gauge representation
- C. The matter field

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.matterField_repAlgebra
declarations.doc:

modules.title: Charged-lepton singlets
modules.doc:
The basis of the charged-lepton singlet `(1, 1)_{-6}`, its Lorentz and gauge actions on
components, and the gauge weights of the components.

## i. Overview

The Standard Model charged-lepton singlet is a right-handed Weyl spinor in the `(1, 1)_{-6}`
representation. Here charges are normalized as `6Y`, so `-6` is the usual hypercharge
`Y = -1`. Its value space `LeptonSinglet`, the Lorentz action `LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup`
and the gauge action `LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI` are in
`Physlib.Particles.StandardModel.Fermions.LeptonSinglet`. The Weyl spinor carries the Lorentz
index and is the whole of the multiplet, a charged-lepton singlet having no colour and no
weak-isospin index.

This file writes both actions on the Weyl basis, together with their dual, conjugate and
conjugate-dual forms, which are what a component of a lepton-singlet symbol needs. The centre
`-1` of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts by `-1`, as on any single Weyl-spinor index. The gauge group acts by the
hypercharge scalar alone, so the gauge torus acts diagonally with weight hypercharge `-6`.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.basis` : the Weyl basis.
- `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis`,
  `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis` : the Lorentz and gauge actions on
  the basis, with their dual and conjugate forms.
- `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one` : the centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts by `-1`.
- `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight` : the gauge weights of the basis, with
  `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The basis
- B. The Lorentz action on components
- C. The gauge action on components
- D. The gauge weights of the components

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The basis

## B. The Lorentz action on components

The Lorentz group acts through the right-handed Weyl representation. Dualising inverts and
transposes the coefficient matrix, and conjugating stars it.

## C. The gauge action on components

The gauge group acts by the hypercharge scalar alone, the colour and weak factors acting
trivially.

## D. The gauge weights of the components

The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonSinglet`. The weights are recorded by
`LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight`, and pass to the dual and conjugate-dual coordinate
functionals with the expected signs.

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.basis
declarations.doc: A basis on the charged-lepton singlets.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℂ LeptonSinglet

declarations.doc: The charged-lepton-singlet space is finite-dimensional.
declarations.statement: instance : Module.Finite ℂ LeptonSinglet

declarations.doc: The charged-lepton-singlet space is free.
declarations.statement: instance : Module.Free ℂ LeptonSinglet

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.basis_eq_mk
declarations.doc: The charged-lepton-singlet basis vector as an explicit Weyl spinor.
declarations.statement: lemma basis_eq_mk (α : Fin 2) : basis α = ⟨Fermion.RightHandedWeyl.basis α⟩

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the lepton-singlet basis is the right-handed Weyl action, by the
entrywise conjugate matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis α) = ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β α) • basis β

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The lepton-singlet coordinate functionals transform contragrediently, by the entrywise
conjugate of the inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis α) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 α β) • basis.dualBasis β

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate lepton-singlet basis. The coefficients are the
conjugates of those of the lepton action, that is, the matrix itself.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) α) = ∑ β, Λ.1 β α • (Basis.conj basis) β

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc: The conjugate lepton-singlet coordinate functionals transform by the inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis α) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 α β • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis β

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the charged-lepton-singlet space by `-1`. The value
space carries a single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer
spin.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre acts on the conjugate charged-lepton-singlet space by `-1` as well,
conjugation not moving a real sign.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the lepton-singlet basis is multiplication by the hypercharge
scalar, the colour and weak factors acting trivially.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis α) = (star g.toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • basis α

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The lepton-singlet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action, the
hypercharge scalar of the inverse group element.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis α) =
      (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • basis.dualBasis α

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the conjugate lepton-singlet basis is the hypercharge scalar,
conjugated.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) α) =
      star (star g.toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • (Basis.conj basis) α

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The conjugate lepton-singlet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
contragredient gauge action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis α) =
      star (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis α

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight
declarations.doc: The gauge weight of the lepton-singlet basis, hypercharge `-6`.
declarations.statement: def valueGaugeWeight (_ : Fin 2) : GaugeWeight

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonSinglet`, with the weights
`LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight`.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonSinglet.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        LeptonSinglet.basis j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
`LeptonSinglet` negates the weights.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonSinglet.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        LeptonSinglet.basis.coord j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
of the conjugate of `LeptonSinglet`. The two negations cancel and the weights are those of
the value space.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i)
      (((Basis.conj LeptonSinglet.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj LeptonSinglet.basis)).coord j

modules.title: The infinitesimal gauge action on the charged-lepton singlet
modules.doc:
The explicit `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the gauge algebra on the charged-lepton singlet, and its
agreement with the matter field.

## i. Overview

The charged-lepton singlet carries the `(1, 1)_{-6}` representation of the gauge group,
so the infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra is scalar, multiplication by
`i` times `-6` times the `u(1)` value of the algebra element. This file defines that
action and identifies it with the action of the gauge algebra of the matter field of
the charged-lepton singlet, through the isomorphism of the gauge algebra with the Lie algebra
of the global gauge group.

## ii. Key results

- `gaugeAlgebraAction` : the infinitesimal `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the gauge algebra.
- `matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv` : the action of the gauge algebra of the
  matter field is `gaugeAlgebraAction`.
- `gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup` : the gauge action commutes with the Lorentz
  action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra
- B. The action of the matter field
- C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra

The `(1, 1)_{-6}` representation acts through the `u(1)` factor alone, so its
derivative is scalar multiplication by `i (-6)` times the `u(1)` value.
## B. The action of the matter field
## C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the charged-lepton singlet, the derivative
of the `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the gauge group. It is scalar multiplication by `i` times `-6`
times the `u(1)` value, real-linear in the algebra slot and complex-linear in the value
slot.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction_apply
declarations.doc:
The gauge-algebra action on the charged-lepton singlet is scalar multiplication
by `i` times `-6` times the `u(1)` value.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_apply (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    gaugeAlgebraAction c
      = (Complex.I * (-(6 : ℂ) * c.toU1Value))
        • (LinearMap.id : LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv
declarations.doc:
The action of the gauge algebra of the matter field of the charged-lepton singlet,
evaluated on the image of a gauge algebra element, is `gaugeAlgebraAction`.
declarations.statement:
lemma matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    matterField.repAlgebra (gaugeAlgebraEquiv c) = gaugeAlgebraAction c

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the charged-lepton singlet is a scalar, so it
commutes with the Lorentz action.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : LeptonSinglet) :
    LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c (LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ (LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

modules.title: The charged-lepton singlet as a matter field
modules.doc:
The charged-lepton singlet `(1, 1)_{-6}` as a matter field of the Standard Model global gauge
group.

## i. Overview

The target space `LeptonSinglet` is normed by the coordinates of its basis. A charged-lepton
singlet is a right-handed Weyl spinor with a trivial internal index, and the global gauge group
acts on it by the power `-6` of the hypercharge phase. This is the charge `-6` twist of the
trivial matrix representation, which gives a matter field of mass weight three. Its action of
the global gauge group, on the image of `StandardModel.gaugeGroupEquiv`, is the existing action
`StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI`.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.matterField` : the charged-lepton singlet as a matter field of
  `StandardModel.globalGaugeGroup`.
- `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.matterField_repAlgebra` : its action of the gauge algebra.
- `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.matterField_rep_gaugeGroupEquiv` : its action of the gauge
  group is `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI`.
- `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.matterField_lorentzContinuous`,
  `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.matterField_gaugeLorentzCommute` :
  its Lorentz action is continuous and commutes with its gauge action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The normed structure
- B. The matter field
- C. Its actions

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. The normed structure

The target space is normed by the largest modulus of its coordinates in its basis.

## B. The matter field

The field is a right-handed Weyl spinor with a trivial internal index, and its gauge group
acts through the hypercharge only.
## C. Its actions

modules.title: Quark doublets
modules.doc:
The basis of the quark doublet `(3, 2)_{1}`, its Lorentz and gauge actions on components, and
the gauge weights of the components.

## i. Overview

The Standard Model quark doublet is a left-handed Weyl spinor in the `(3, 2)_{1}`
representation. Here charges are normalized as `6Y`, so `1` is the usual hypercharge
`Y = 1/6`. Its value space `QuarkDoublet`, the Lorentz action `QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup`
and the gauge action `QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI` are in
`Physlib.Particles.StandardModel.Fermions.QuarkDoublet`. The Weyl factor carries the Lorentz
index, and the colour and weak-isospin factors the internal indices.

The colour and weak indices are combined into the single index `Fin 3 × Fin 2` by
`QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEquiv`, on which a gauge transformation acts through the Kronecker
product of its `SU(3)` and `SU(2)` matrices. This file then writes both actions on the basis of
spinor–colour–weak tensors, together with their dual, conjugate and conjugate-dual forms, which
are what a component of a quark-doublet symbol needs. The centre `-1` of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts by
`-1`, as on any single Weyl-spinor index. The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis, with the
colour and isospin weights and hypercharge `1`.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEquiv` : the colour and weak factors combined into a
  single factor over `Fin 3 × Fin 2`.
- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.basis` : the basis of spinor–colour–weak tensors.
- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis`,
  `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis` : the Lorentz and gauge actions on
  the basis, with their dual and conjugate forms.
- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one` : the centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts by `-1`.
- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight` : the gauge weights of the basis, with
  `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The combined colour and weak index
- B. The basis
- C. The Lorentz action on components
- D. The gauge action on components
- E. The gauge weights of the components

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. The combined colour and weak index

The colour and weak indices are combined into the single index `Fin 3 × Fin 2`, on which
the `SU(3)` and `SU(2)` matrices of a gauge transformation act together through their
Kronecker product, scaled by the hypercharge phase.

## B. The basis

The basis of `QuarkDoublet` is the tensor product of the left-handed Weyl basis and the
standard colour and weak bases.

## C. The Lorentz action on components

The Lorentz group moves only the spinor index. Dualising inverts and transposes the coefficient
matrix, and conjugating stars it.

## D. The gauge action on components

The gauge group moves only the colour and weak indices, up to the hypercharge scalar.

## E. The gauge weights of the components

The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `QuarkDoublet`. The weights are recorded by
`QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight`, and pass to the dual and conjugate-dual coordinate
functionals with the expected signs.

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEquiv
declarations.doc:
The colour and weak factors of the quark doublet combined into a single Euclidean
factor over `Fin 3 × Fin 2`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def colourWeakEquiv :
    EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3) ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2) ≃ₗ[ℂ] (Fin 3 × Fin 2 → ℂ)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEquiv_tmul
declarations.doc: The combined index of a pure colour–weak tensor is the product of its components.
declarations.statement:
lemma colourWeakEquiv_tmul (c : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3)) (w : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2))
    (p : Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    colourWeakEquiv (c ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w) p = c.ofLp p.1 * w.ofLp p.2

declarations.doc: A basis on the quark doublets.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ QuarkDoublet

declarations.doc: The quark-doublet space is finite-dimensional.
declarations.statement: instance : Module.Finite ℂ QuarkDoublet

declarations.doc: The quark-doublet space is free.
declarations.statement: instance : Module.Free ℂ QuarkDoublet

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.basis_eq_mk
declarations.doc: The quark-doublet basis vector as an explicit spinor–colour–weak tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_eq_mk (k : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3) (w : Fin 2) : basis (k, c, w) =
    ⟨Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℂ c
      ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℂ w⟩

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the quark-doublet basis. The colour and weak indices are inert
and the spinor index transforms by the matrix itself.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis j) = ∑ β, Λ.1 β j.1 • basis (β, j.2.1, j.2.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The quark-doublet coordinate functionals transform contragrediently, by the inverse
matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β • basis.dualBasis (β, j.2.1, j.2.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate quark-doublet basis. The coefficients are the
conjugates of those of the quark-doublet action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β j.1) • (Basis.conj basis) (β, j.2.1, j.2.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The conjugate quark-doublet coordinate functionals transform by the entrywise
conjugate of the inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β) • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (β, j.2.1, j.2.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the quark-doublet space by `-1`. The value space carries a
single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer spin.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre acts on the conjugate quark-doublet space by `-1` as well, conjugation not
moving a real sign.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the quark-doublet basis. The spinor index is inert, the colour
index transforms by the `SU(3)` matrix and the weak index by the `SU(2)` matrix, scaled
by the hypercharge factor.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis j) =
      ∑ c, ∑ w, (g.toU1.1 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2.1 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2.2) • basis (j.1, c, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The quark-doublet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action, by the
hypercharge, `SU(3)` and `SU(2)` factors of the inverse group element, transposed.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, ∑ w, ((g⁻¹).toU1.1 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2.1 c * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2.2 w) •
        basis.dualBasis (j.1, c, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the conjugate quark-doublet basis has the coefficients of the
quark-doublet action, conjugated.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ c, ∑ w, star (g.toU1.1 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2.1 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2.2) •
        (Basis.conj basis) (j.1, c, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The conjugate quark-doublet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
contragredient gauge action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, ∑ w, star ((g⁻¹).toU1.1 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2.1 c * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2.2 w) •
        (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (j.1, c, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight
declarations.doc:
The gauge weight of the quark-doublet basis, colour and isospin weights and
hypercharge `1`.
declarations.statement: def valueGaugeWeight (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) : GaugeWeight

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `QuarkDoublet`, with the weights
`QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight`.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (QuarkDoublet.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        QuarkDoublet.basis j

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
`QuarkDoublet` negates the weights.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (QuarkDoublet.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        QuarkDoublet.basis.coord j

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
of the conjugate of `QuarkDoublet`. The two negations cancel and the weights are those of
the value space.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3 × Fin 2) :
    QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i)
      (((Basis.conj QuarkDoublet.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (QuarkDoublet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj QuarkDoublet.basis)).coord j

modules.title: The infinitesimal gauge action on the quark doublet
modules.doc:
The explicit `(3, 2)_{1}` action of the gauge algebra on the quark doublet, and its agreement
with the matter field.

## i. Overview

The `(3, 2)_{1}` action of the gauge algebra on the quark doublet. The colour and weak
parts of the algebra element act on the combined colour–weak index through the Kronecker
sum, and the hypercharge part scales, all through the physicists' factor of `i`, matching
the group action `u • (U₃ ⊗ₖ U₂)` infinitesimally. The action is the action of the gauge
algebra of the matter field of the quark doublet, transported along
`StandardModel.gaugeAlgebraEquiv`, and it commutes with the Lorentz action.

## ii. Key results

- `colourWeakEnd` : the endomorphism of the quark doublet defined by a colour–weak
  matrix.
- `gaugeAlgebraAction` : the infinitesimal `(3, 2)_{1}` action of the gauge algebra.
- `matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv` : the action of the gauge algebra of the
  matter field is `gaugeAlgebraAction`.
- `gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup` : the gauge action commutes with the Lorentz
  action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The action of the gauge algebra
- B. The matter field
- C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The action of the gauge algebra
## B. The matter field
## C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakValLinEquiv
declarations.doc:
The complex-linear identification of the quark doublet with a left-handed Weyl spinor
tensored with a colour–weak vector over the combined index `Fin 3 × Fin 2`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def colourWeakValLinEquiv :
    QuarkDoublet ≃ₗ[ℂ] Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl ⊗[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3 × Fin 2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd
declarations.doc:
The endomorphism of the quark doublet defined by a complex matrix over the
combined colour–weak index, with the Weyl factor untouched.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def colourWeakEnd (A : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ) :
    QuarkDoublet →ₗ[ℂ] QuarkDoublet

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_apply_mk
declarations.statement:
lemma colourWeakEnd_apply_mk (A : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ)
    (v : QuarkDoublet) :
    colourWeakEnd A v
      = colourWeakValLinEquiv.symm
          (Module.End.lTensorAlgHom ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3 × Fin 2))
            Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl
            (Matrix.toLpLinAlgEquiv 2 A) (colourWeakValLinEquiv v))

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_add
declarations.statement:
lemma colourWeakEnd_add (A B : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ) :
    colourWeakEnd (A + B) = colourWeakEnd A + colourWeakEnd B

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma colourWeakEnd_smul (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ) :
    colourWeakEnd (z • A) = z • colourWeakEnd A

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.actionMatrix
declarations.doc:
The matrix of the infinitesimal `(3, 2)_{1}` action of a gauge algebra element on
the combined colour–weak index, `i` times the Kronecker sum of the colour and weak
parts shifted by `i` times the hypercharge.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def actionMatrix (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.gaugeAlgebraAction
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the quark doublet, the derivative of
the `(3, 2)_{1}` action of the gauge group, real-linear in the algebra slot and
complex-linear in the value slot.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] QuarkDoublet →ₗ[ℂ] QuarkDoublet

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.colourWeakEnd_eq_valEnd
declarations.doc:
The colour–weak endomorphism of a matrix is the endomorphism of the matter field
of the quark doublet defined by that matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma colourWeakEnd_eq_valEnd (A : Matrix (Fin 3 × Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 2) ℂ) :
    colourWeakEnd A = MatrixRep.valEnd tensorEquiv A

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.derivMat_gaugeRep_gaugeAlgebraEquiv
declarations.doc:
The matrix of the action of the gauge algebra element `gaugeAlgebraEquiv c` in the
gauge representation of the quark doublet is `actionMatrix c`.
declarations.statement:
lemma derivMat_gaugeRep_gaugeAlgebraEquiv (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    derivMat gaugeRep (gaugeAlgebraEquiv c) = actionMatrix c

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv
declarations.doc:
The action of the gauge algebra of the matter field of the quark doublet, on the
image of `gaugeAlgebraEquiv`, is `gaugeAlgebraAction`.
declarations.statement:
lemma matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    matterField.repAlgebra (gaugeAlgebraEquiv c) = gaugeAlgebraAction c

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the quark doublet acts on the combined colour–weak
factor, the Lorentz action on the Weyl factor, so the two commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : QuarkDoublet) :
    QuarkDoublet.gaugeAlgebraAction c (QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      QuarkDoublet.repLorentzGroup Λ (QuarkDoublet.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

modules.title: The quark doublet as a matter field
modules.doc:
The quark doublet `(3, 2)_1` as a matter field of the Standard Model global gauge group.

## i. Overview

The target space `QuarkDoublet` is normed by the coordinates of its basis. A quark doublet is a
left-handed Weyl spinor with a combined colour and weak index in `Fin 3 × Fin 2`, and the global
gauge group acts on it by the hypercharge phase times the Kronecker product of the `SU(3)` and
`SU(2)` blocks. This is the charge `1` twist of the Kronecker product of the fundamental
representations of the two factors, which gives a matter field of mass weight three. Its action
of the global gauge group, on the image of `StandardModel.gaugeGroupEquiv`, is the existing
action `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI`.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.matterField` : the quark doublet as a matter field of
  `StandardModel.globalGaugeGroup`.
- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.matterField_repAlgebra` : its action of the gauge algebra.
- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.valEnd_smul_kronecker` : the action of a scaled Kronecker product
  of matrices on the combined colour and weak index.
- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.matterField_rep_gaugeGroupEquiv` : its action of the gauge
  group is `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI`.
- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.matterField_lorentzContinuous`,
  `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.matterField_gaugeLorentzCommute` :
  its Lorentz action is continuous and commutes with its gauge action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The normed structure
- B. The gauge representation
- C. The matter field
- D. The action of matrices on the combined index
- E. The action of the gauge group

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.tensorEquiv
declarations.doc: The quark doublets as a left-handed Weyl spinor with a combined colour and weak index.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def tensorEquiv :
    QuarkDoublet ≃ₗ[ℂ] Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl ⊗[ℂ] (Fin 3 × Fin 2 → ℂ)

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.tensorEquiv_mk
declarations.doc: The identification `tensorEquiv` on a pure tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma tensorEquiv_mk (s : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl) (c : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3))
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2)) :
    tensorEquiv ⟨(s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w⟩ = s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] colourWeakEquiv (c ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w)

declarations.doc: The inverse of the identification `tensorEquiv` on a pure tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma tensorEquiv_symm_tmul (s : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl) (c : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3))

    tensorEquiv.symm (s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] colourWeakEquiv (c ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w)) = ⟨(s ⊗ₜ[ℂ] c) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] w⟩

declarations.doc:
Two linear maps on the quark doublets are equal when they agree on the elements built from
pure tensors.

    f = g

declarations.doc:
The action of the gauge algebra of the matter field is the action matrix of its matrix
representation.
declarations.statement:
lemma matterField_repAlgebra (c : globalGaugeGroup.lieSubalgebra) :
    matterField.repAlgebra c = MatrixRep.valEnd tensorEquiv (derivMat gaugeRep c)

declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action of the matter field is that of the left-handed Weyl
spinor.

    matterField.repLorentz = MatrixRep.repLorentz tensorEquiv Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep

declarations.doc: The mass weight of the quark doublet.
declarations.statement: lemma matterField_massWeight : matterField.massWeight = 3

declarations.doc: The quark doublet is fermionic.
declarations.statement: lemma matterField_statistic : matterField.statistic = .fermionic

declarations.doc: The Lorentz action of the matter field of the quark doublet is continuous.

declarations.doc: The gauge and Lorentz representations of the matter field of the quark doublet commute.
declarations.statement: lemma matterField_gaugeLorentzCommute : matterField.GaugeLorentzCommute

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.matterField_repLorentz_eq
declarations.doc: The Lorentz action of the matter field is the left-handed Lorentz action.
declarations.statement:
lemma matterField_repLorentz_eq (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (matterField.repLorentz Λ : QuarkDoublet →ₗ[ℂ] QuarkDoublet) =
      repLorentzGroup Λ

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.valEnd_smul_kronecker
declarations.doc:
The action of a scaled Kronecker product of a colour matrix and a weak matrix on the
quark doublets, through the identification `tensorEquiv`, is the action of the two matrices on the
colour and weak factors, scaled.
declarations.statement:
lemma valEnd_smul_kronecker (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)
    (B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (q : QuarkDoublet) :
    MatrixRep.valEnd tensorEquiv (z • (A ⊗ₖ B)) q =
      ⟨z • TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id A.toEuclideanLin)
        B.toEuclideanLin q.val⟩

declarations.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.matterField_rep_gaugeGroupEquiv
declarations.doc:
The action of the gauge group on the matter field of the quark doublet,
through `gaugeGroupEquiv`, is the action `repGaugeGroupI`.
declarations.statement:
lemma matterField_rep_gaugeGroupEquiv (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    (((matterField.rep (gaugeGroupEquiv g) : _ˣ) :
      matterField.V →L[ℂ] matterField.V) : matterField.V →ₗ[ℂ]
        matterField.V) =
        (repGaugeGroupI g : matterField.V →ₗ[ℂ] matterField.V)

modules.title: Up-type singlets
modules.doc:
The basis of the up-type singlet `(3, 1)_{4}`, its Lorentz and gauge actions on components,
and the gauge weights of the components.

## i. Overview

The Standard Model up-type singlet is a right-handed Weyl spinor in the `(3, 1)_{4}`
representation. Here charges are normalized as `6Y`, so `4` is the usual hypercharge
`Y = 2/3`. Its value space `UpSinglet`, the Lorentz action `UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup` and the
gauge action `UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI` are in `Physlib.Particles.StandardModel.Fermions.UpSinglet`.
The Weyl factor carries the Lorentz index and the three-dimensional factor the colour index.

This file writes both actions on the basis of spinor–colour tensors, together with their dual,
conjugate and conjugate-dual forms, which are what a component of an up-singlet symbol needs.
The centre `-1` of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts by `-1`, as on any single Weyl-spinor index. The gauge torus
acts diagonally on the basis, with the colour weights and hypercharge `4`.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.UpSinglet.basis` : the basis of spinor–colour tensors.
- `StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis`,
  `StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis` : the Lorentz and gauge actions on the
  basis, with their dual and conjugate forms.
- `StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one` : the centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts by `-1`.
- `StandardModel.UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight` : the gauge weights of the basis, with
  `StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The basis
- B. The Lorentz action on components
- C. The gauge action on components
- D. The gauge weights of the components

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. The basis

The basis of `UpSinglet` is the tensor product of the right-handed Weyl basis and the standard
colour basis.

## B. The Lorentz action on components

The Lorentz group moves only the spinor index. Dualising inverts and transposes the coefficient
matrix, and conjugating stars it.

## C. The gauge action on components

The gauge group moves only the colour index, up to the hypercharge scalar.

## D. The gauge weights of the components

The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `UpSinglet`. The weights are recorded by
`UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight`, and pass to the dual and conjugate-dual coordinate
functionals with the expected signs.

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.basis
declarations.doc: A basis on the up singlets.

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.basis_eq_mk
declarations.doc: The up-singlet basis vector as an explicit spinor–colour tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_eq_mk (k : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3) : basis (k, c) =
    ⟨Fermion.RightHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℂ c⟩

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the up-singlet basis. The colour index is inert and the
spinor index transforms by the entrywise conjugate matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis j) = ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β j.1) • basis (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The up-singlet coordinate functionals transform contragrediently, by the entrywise
conjugate of the inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β) • basis.dualBasis (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate up-singlet basis. The coefficients are the
conjugates of those of the up-singlet action, that is, the matrix itself.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) j)
      = ∑ β, Λ.1 β j.1 • (Basis.conj basis) (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc: The conjugate up-singlet coordinate functionals transform by the inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the up-singlet space by `-1`. The value space carries a
single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer spin.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre acts on the conjugate up-singlet space by `-1` as well, conjugation not
moving a real sign.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the up-singlet basis. The spinor index is inert and the colour
index transforms by the `SU(3)` matrix, scaled by the hypercharge factor.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis j) =
      ∑ c, (g.toU1.1 ^ 4 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2) • basis (j.1, c)

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The up-singlet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action, by the
hypercharge and `SU(3)` factors of the inverse group element, transposed.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, ((g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 4 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2 c) • basis.dualBasis (j.1, c)

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the conjugate up-singlet basis has the coefficients of the
up-singlet action, conjugated.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ c, star (g.toU1.1 ^ 4 * g.toSU3.1 c j.2) • (Basis.conj basis) (j.1, c)

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The conjugate up-singlet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
contragredient gauge action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ c, star ((g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 4 * (g⁻¹).toSU3.1 j.2 c) •
        (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (j.1, c)

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight
declarations.doc:
The gauge weight of the up-singlet basis, colour weights and hypercharge
`4`.
declarations.statement: def valueGaugeWeight (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) : GaugeWeight

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `UpSinglet`, with the weights
`UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight`.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (UpSinglet.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        UpSinglet.basis j

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
`UpSinglet` negates the weights.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (UpSinglet.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        UpSinglet.basis.coord j

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
of the conjugate of `UpSinglet`. The two negations cancel and the weights are those of
the value space.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 3) :
    UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (((Basis.conj UpSinglet.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (UpSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj UpSinglet.basis)).coord j

modules.title: The infinitesimal gauge action on the up-type singlet
modules.doc:
The explicit `(3, 1)_{4}` action of the gauge algebra on the up-type singlet, and its agreement
with the matter field.

## i. Overview

The `(3, 1)_{4}` action of the gauge algebra on the up-type singlet. The colour part of
the algebra element acts on the colour index and the hypercharge part scales, both
through the physicists' factor of `i`, matching the group action `u ^ 4 • U₃`
infinitesimally. This action is the action of the gauge algebra of the matter field
`UpSinglet.matterField`, transported along `gaugeAlgebraEquiv`, and it commutes with
the Lorentz action.

## ii. Key results

- `colourEnd` : the endomorphism of the up singlet defined by a colour matrix.
- `gaugeAlgebraAction` : the infinitesimal `(3, 1)_{4}` action of the gauge algebra.
- `matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv` : the gauge algebra action of the matrix
  matter field is `gaugeAlgebraAction`.
- `gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup` : the gauge action commutes with the Lorentz
  action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The action of the gauge algebra
- B. Comparison with the matter field
- C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The action of the gauge algebra
## B. Comparison with the matter field
## C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd
declarations.doc:
The endomorphism of the up singlet defined by a `3 × 3` complex matrix acting on
the colour index, with the Weyl factor untouched.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def colourEnd (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    UpSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] UpSinglet

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_apply_mk
declarations.statement:
lemma colourEnd_apply_mk (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) (v : UpSinglet) :
    colourEnd A v
      = valLinEquiv.symm
          (Module.End.lTensorAlgHom ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3)) Fermion.RightHandedWeyl
            (Matrix.toLpLinAlgEquiv 2 A) (valLinEquiv v))

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_add
declarations.statement:
lemma colourEnd_add (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    colourEnd (A + B) = colourEnd A + colourEnd B

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma colourEnd_smul (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    colourEnd (z • A) = z • colourEnd A

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.actionMatrix
declarations.doc:
The matrix of the infinitesimal `(3, 1)_{4}` action of a gauge algebra element on
the colour index, `i` times the colour part shifted by `i` times `4` the
hypercharge.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def actionMatrix (c : GaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the up-type singlet, the
derivative of the `(3, 1)_{4}` action of the gauge group, real-linear in the
algebra slot and complex-linear in the value slot.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] UpSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] UpSinglet

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.colourEnd_eq_valEnd
declarations.doc:
The colour endomorphism of a matrix is the endomorphism of the matrix representation
picture `tensorEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
lemma colourEnd_eq_valEnd (B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ) :
    colourEnd B = MatrixRep.valEnd tensorEquiv B

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv
declarations.doc:
The action of the gauge algebra of the matter field of the up-type singlet, on the
image of `gaugeAlgebraEquiv`, is `gaugeAlgebraAction`.
declarations.statement:
lemma matterField_repAlgebra_gaugeAlgebraEquiv (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    matterField.repAlgebra (gaugeAlgebraEquiv c) = gaugeAlgebraAction c

declarations.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the up-type singlet acts on the colour factor, the
Lorentz action on the Weyl factor, so the two commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : UpSinglet) :
    UpSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c (UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ (UpSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

modules.title: The up-type singlet as a matter field
modules.doc:
The up-type singlet `(3, 1)_{4}` as a matter field of the Standard Model global
gauge group.

## i. Overview

The target space `UpSinglet` is normed by the coordinates of its basis. An up-type singlet is a
right-handed Weyl spinor with a colour index in `Fin 3`, and the global gauge group acts on it by
the fundamental representation of the `SU(3)` block twisted by the power `4` of the hypercharge
phase. This is the charge `4` twist of the fundamental representation of the colour factor,
which gives a matter field of mass weight three. Its action of the global gauge group, on the
image of `StandardModel.gaugeGroupEquiv`, is the existing action
`StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI`.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.UpSinglet.matterField` : the up-type singlet as a matter field of
  `StandardModel.globalGaugeGroup`.
- `StandardModel.UpSinglet.matterField_repAlgebra` : its action of the gauge algebra.
- `StandardModel.UpSinglet.matterField_rep_gaugeGroupEquiv` : its action of the gauge
  group is `StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI`.
- `StandardModel.UpSinglet.matterField_lorentzContinuous`,
  `StandardModel.UpSinglet.matterField_gaugeLorentzCommute` :
  its Lorentz action is continuous and commutes with its gauge action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The normed structure
- B. The gauge representation
- C. The matter field

## iv. References

* None.

modules.title: The field data of the Standard Model
modules.doc:
The fifteen fermion species and the Higgs as the field data over the Standard Model global
gauge group, with their conditions and mass weights.

## i. Overview

`GaugeFieldData G` is the matter content of a gauge theory over a global gauge group `G`, a
family of fermionic species and a family of bosonic species, each given by a
`MatterField`. The Standard Model has all the pieces, the global gauge group
`StandardModel.globalGaugeGroup` and the five fermion types and the Higgs already packaged as
matter fields, and this file assembles them into `StandardModel.fieldData`.

The fermionic species are the constructors of `FermionType`, fifteen multiplets, one of
the five types in one of the three generations, each occurring exactly once. The
generation index is an argument of each constructor, so the species type is the
enumeration itself and carries no further factor. The matter field does not depend on the
generation, three generations being three copies of one multiplet distinguished only by
their Yukawa couplings, which are not field data. The bosonic family has the single Higgs
multiplet. The fermions are declared fermionic and the Higgs bosonic, as `GaugeFieldData`
requires of its two families. The gauge bosons are not a species. Their generator space is
fixed by the gauge algebra alone, and `GaugeFieldData` supplies it as the connection sector.

From the datum the generic theory produces the generator spaces, the local field algebra
`fieldData.LocalFieldAlgebra`, the transformation data and the realization arrow, with no
further Standard Model input.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.FermionType` : the fifteen fermion species, the five types in each of
  the three generations.
- `StandardModel.fieldData` : the field data of the Standard Model.
- `StandardModel.card_fieldData_fermionSpecies`,
  `StandardModel.card_fieldData_bosonSpecies` : fifteen fermionic multiplets, one Higgs.
- `StandardModel.fieldData_lorentzContinuous`, `StandardModel.fieldData_gaugeLorentzCommute` :
  the Lorentz representations are continuous and commute with the gauge representations.
- `StandardModel.fieldData_gaugeLorentzCompatible` : the datum satisfies the condition
  of the covariant derivative theory, derived from `StandardModel.fieldData_gaugeLorentzCommute`.
- `StandardModel.fieldData_mem_invariants_iff_exists_mem_invariants` : the invariants of any
  realization of the local field algebra of the Standard Model are the images of the invariants
  of its covariant field algebra.
- `StandardModel.fieldData_massWeightScaleFermion_inclFermion_basis_tmul`,
  `StandardModel.fieldData_massWeightScaleBoson_inclBoson_basis_tmul` : a fermionic component
  function `∂_s ψ_α` scales by `c ^ (3 + 2 |s|)`, a Higgs component by `c ^ (2 + 2 |s|)`.
- `StandardModel.massWeightPoly_fieldData_fermionSymbol`,
  `StandardModel.massWeightPoly_fieldData_bosonSymbol` and their conjugates : the fermion
  symbols have mass weight `3 + 2 |s|`, the Higgs symbols `2 + 2 |s|`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The fermion species
- B. The field datum
- C. The conditions on the species
- D. The mass weights

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The fermion species
## B. The field datum

## C. The conditions on the species

The global gauge group of the Standard Model is compact, and on every species the Lorentz
representation is continuous and commutes with the gauge representation. These are the
hypotheses under which the invariants of a realization of the local field algebra descend to
the covariant field algebra. The commutation implies its infinitesimal form
`GaugeFieldData.GaugeLorentzCompatible`, the condition of the covariant derivative theory.

## D. The mass weights

A Standard Model fermion carries mass weight three and the Higgs weight two, in the units
in which a derivative has weight two. The first two are read off the matter fields, the
third is already built into the generator spaces.

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionType
declarations.doc:
The fifteen fermion species of the Standard Model, each of the five fermion types in
each of the three generations, the generation `i : Fin 3` carried by the constructor.
Two generations of one type share a matter field but are distinct species.
declarations.statement:
inductive FermionType where
  /-- The lepton doublet of generation `i`, `(1, 2)_{-3}`. -/
  | leptonDoublet (i : Fin 3) : FermionType
  /-- The charged-lepton singlet of generation `i`, `(1, 1)_{-6}`. -/
  | leptonSinglet (i : Fin 3) : FermionType
  /-- The quark doublet of generation `i`, `(3, 2)_{1}`. -/
  | quarkDoublet (i : Fin 3) : FermionType
  /-- The up-type quark singlet of generation `i`, `(3, 1)_{4}`. -/
  | upSinglet (i : Fin 3) : FermionType
  /-- The down-type quark singlet of generation `i`, `(3, 1)_{-2}`. -/
  | downSinglet (i : Fin 3) : FermionType

deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

declarations.doc: The Lorentz action on every fermionic species of the Standard Model is continuous.

declarations.name: StandardModel.fieldData_mem_invariants_iff_exists_mem_invariants
declarations.doc:
The invariants of a realization of the local field algebra of the Standard Model are the
images of the invariants of its covariant field algebra. An element `k x` is invariant under
the jet gauge group and the Lorentz group exactly when it is the image of a covariant
expression invariant under the ordinary gauge group and the Lorentz group.
declarations.statement:
lemma fieldData_mem_invariants_iff_exists_mem_invariants {B : Type} [Ring B] [Algebra ℂ B]
    {repJet : Representation ℂ globalGaugeGroup.gaugeJetGroup B}
    {repLorentz : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) B}
    (k : GaugeFieldData.Realization fieldData B repJet repLorentz)
    (x : fieldData.LocalFieldAlgebra) :
    k.toAlgHom x ∈ repJet.invariants ∧ k.toAlgHom x ∈ repLorentz.invariants ↔
      ∃ a' : fieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra,
        a' ∈ (GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repValue fieldData).invariants ∧
        a' ∈ (GaugeFieldData.LocalCovFieldAlgebra.repLorentzGroup fieldData
          fieldData_gaugeLorentzCompatible).invariants ∧
        k.toAlgHom (a' : fieldData.LocalFieldAlgebra) = k.toAlgHom x

modules.title: The gauge algebra of the Standard Model
modules.doc:
The Lie algebra of `SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1)` in the hermitian convention, with its adjoint action.

## i. Overview

The gauge algebra of the Standard Model is the Lie algebra of `GaugeGroupI`, the direct sum of
the Lie algebras of `SU(3)`, `SU(2)` and `U(1)`. Following the physics convention, its elements
are written with hermitian generators. An element is a triple `(c₃, c₂, c₁)` of a traceless
hermitian `3 × 3` matrix, a traceless hermitian `2 × 2` matrix and a real scalar, and the
corresponding element of the matrix Lie algebra is `diag(i c₃, i c₂, i c₁)`. The bracket is
therefore `i` times the matrix commutator, which keeps hermitian matrices hermitian but is only
real-bilinear. The identification with the Lie algebra of the global gauge group is
`gaugeAlgebraEquiv`, in `GaugeGroup/LieAlgebra.lean`.

The gauge group acts on its gauge algebra by conjugation of the `su(3)` and `su(2)` factors,
leaving the abelian `u(1)` factor fixed.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra` : the gauge algebra of the Standard Model.
- `StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.toSU3Matrix`, `StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.toSU2Matrix`,
  `StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.toU1Value` : the components of an element in the three factors.
- The instance `LieAlgebra ℝ GaugeAlgebra` : the bracket `i [a, b]` on each factor.
- `StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra.adjoint` : the adjoint action of the gauge group.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. Basic projections
- B. Constructor from a product of matrices
- C. The Lie algebra instance
- D. The adjoint action of the gauge group

## iv. References

* None.

declarations.name: StandardModel.GaugeAlgebra
declarations.doc:
The gauge algebra of the Standard Model, the Lie algebra of `GaugeGroupI` in the hermitian
convention. It has one factor per gauge group factor, the traceless self-adjoint `3 × 3` and
`2 × 2` complex matrices and the self-adjoint (that is, real) scalars. It is identified with
the Lie algebra of `globalGaugeGroup` by `gaugeAlgebraEquiv`.
declarations.statement: abbrev GaugeAlgebra

declarations.doc:

identification with the corresponding submodule.
